description: Phase 6y gate — CASE expression, simple and searched forms. No new VDBE opcodes. max_invariant=43 unchanged. Algorithm per spec/sql-grammar.spec.md § 'Phase 6y'. All prior phase fixtures must stay green.

program.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'a' WHEN 1 THEN 'b' END;
SELECT CASE WHEN 0 THEN 'a' WHEN 1 THEN 'b' END;
SELECT CASE WHEN 0 THEN 'a' WHEN 0 THEN 'b' END IS NULL;
SELECT CASE WHEN 0 THEN 'a' ELSE 'z' END;

cases.name: searched-case-null-condition-treated-as-false
cases.description: Null WHEN condition → skip to next (SQL 3VL: Null is not truthy).

program.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN NULL THEN 'a' WHEN 1 THEN 'b' ELSE 'z' END;
SELECT CASE WHEN NULL THEN 'a' WHEN NULL THEN 'b' ELSE 'z' END;
SELECT CASE WHEN NULL THEN 'a' WHEN NULL THEN 'b' END IS NULL;
SELECT CASE 1 WHEN 1 THEN 'a' WHEN 2 THEN 'b' END;
SELECT CASE 2 WHEN 1 THEN 'a' WHEN 2 THEN 'b' END;
SELECT CASE 3 WHEN 1 THEN 'a' WHEN 2 THEN 'b' ELSE 'z' END;
SELECT CASE 3 WHEN 1 THEN 'a' WHEN 2 THEN 'b' END IS NULL;

cases.name: simple-case-null-scrutinee-falls-to-else
cases.description: CASE NULL WHEN 1 ... : NULL = 1 is Null, so no WHEN matches; ELSE applies.

program.sql: SELECT CASE NULL WHEN 1 THEN 'a' ELSE 'z' END;
SELECT CASE NULL WHEN 1 THEN 'a' WHEN 2 THEN 'b' END IS NULL;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1), (2), (3);
SELECT CASE WHEN a = 1 THEN 'one' WHEN a = 2 THEN 'two' ELSE 'other' END FROM t ORDER BY a;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1), (2), (3);
SELECT CASE a WHEN 1 THEN 'x' WHEN 2 THEN 'y' ELSE 'z' END FROM t ORDER BY a;

cases.name: case-result-types-mixed
cases.description: CASE arms may return different types; each row emits the type of its selected arm.

program.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN 1 THEN 42 END;
SELECT CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'text' END;
SELECT CASE WHEN 0 THEN 42 ELSE 'text' END;
SELECT CASE WHEN 1 THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'inner' END END;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1), (2), (3);
SELECT a FROM t WHERE CASE WHEN a = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ORDER BY a;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1), (2), (3);
SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY CASE WHEN a = 2 THEN 0 ELSE a END;

cases.name: case-empty-when-list-rejected
cases.description: CASE with no WHEN clauses is a parse error.

program.sql: SELECT CASE ELSE 'z' END;

cases.name: case-unterminated-rejected
cases.description: Missing END is a parse error.

program.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'a';

cases.name: simple-case-scrutinee-evaluated-once
cases.description: Demonstration: in Simple CASE, scrutinee is evaluated once even against many WHENs. We can't directly observe this without side-effects, but we can verify correctness against a column reference (every row routes correctly).

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1), (2), (3), (4), (5);
SELECT a, CASE a WHEN 1 THEN 'one' WHEN 2 THEN 'two' WHEN 3 THEN 'three' ELSE 'other' END FROM t ORDER BY a;
